title: COVID-19 Vaccine Immune Responses Study (COVIRS)
description: Blood collected from adults pre vaccination and post vaccination to study the immune effects of COVID-19 vaccination and how they relate to antibody and T-cell responses. Overall design: Total RNA sequenced from healthy adults pre vaccination (V0), 7 days after dose 1 (V1) and 2 days after dose 3 (V3A) for COVID-19 vaccines
